rna.text: Arrus is a Viashino tattooist of the Ghor Clan who, in Ravnica Allegiance, tampers with the recipe for his magical tattoo ink because the maaka scat is poor. At the ruined battlefront Rage spreads through the crowd, but Arrus can only pretend to feel it, and Dryzek hints that he knows Arrus's heart is cold.

The ink Arrus made bursts into flame on Jiri, Dryzek and other warriors, and Ruric and Thar cast Arrus out of the clan. Clanless, he notices that the Rubblebelt's plants, animals and food are all failing and tries to warn Jiri, who refuses to listen.

Arrus tries to steal the ink of the ogre shaman, who beats him up, and Selesnyan vine magic from spilled ink heals him. He recognizes the ogre as Baas Radley, who teaches him to face down a charging battleboar herd.

Arrus discovers that trees on the Selesnyan border are only five years old, planted as a fast-grown barrier that leeches magic from the Rubblebelt. He challenges Ruric and Thar for clan chieftain and is beaten, until he finds his Rage, rooted in anger at his people's lost stories, and rises from the beating.

Arrus tells the clan that Selesnya is draining the Rubblebelt, and Jiri, Baas, Dryzek and others join him in flames, so Ruric and Thar accept his challenge, set themselves alight and declare war on Selesnya.
